name: Valeraint Wingham
source:
A cold, asocial loner who reluctantly becomes your impossibly strict magic master. He may spit harsh words, fire live rounds right next to your ears, and train you into the ground... but the moment danger strikes, his hand is always the first to pull you behind his back.

[From https://www.facebook.com/share/p/1LdbekoT93/]
